text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okay, first I have to go to the
gymnasium... Wait,
no, that's not right...
Oh, why am I so forgetful?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. I'm rehearsing for tomorrow.
I'm not
doing a good job though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the Halloween Parade, and
guests
from outside the academy have
been invited to
attend. Meisho Doto's
role is to hand out candy
to the children.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Just the thought of so many children
watching me
makes me nervous... What if
I forget my lines?
What if I forget the
procession route?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Nnghh! Okay, one m-more time! I'll focus
and
memorize everything to a T!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Doto! We'd be down to practice
with...
you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Doto. Why do you have a pumpkin on
your
head?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well, I feel like this calms me down
and helps
with my concentration... So, I
wanted to try going
through the route
with it on.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're regulating your emotions
by cutting
off your field of vision.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've got an idea! What if you wear the
pumpkin
for the real thing? That way
you won't get
nervous!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that could work! But... won't the
children be
scared of me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No matter. We can alter our costumes
and bring
Halloween to life for these
children! Let us tell a
tale dressed as
monsters and ghouls!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Surely then Doto's costume would no
longer be
frightening in comparison!
Why don't we all take
to the stage?

text_block_list.name: Top Road and Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
All right.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You would do that... for me? Uuugh,
thank you so
much, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Halloween Parade.
T.M. Opera
O appears before the large
crowd of children!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, o ghoulish juveniles! I am the
king of
ghouls and monsters. I presume
you all like
candy?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: We loooove candy!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it! What is Halloween
without
candy? Minions, instruct them as
to how they
might acquire some.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... am the spirit of darkness. I shall teach
you a
spell, so listen well... Trick or
treat.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
These words seize... the deepest crevices
of
hearts. The adults will be cast into
darkness. And
before you know it...
candy will be in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Did you get that, everyone? Scaredy-cat
or not,
say it along with me, captain of
the ghouls!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's all become the spookiest of ghouls
together!
Trick or treat!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Trick or treat!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Splendid! I shall introduce
my final
friend, so heed what she has to
say!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(It's finally my turn! It's o-okay, I'm a
pumpkin
now... I can do this!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I a-am the pumpkin ghoul... I'll be taking
things
from here.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You c-can call me "Miss Pumpkin" if you
like. I
mean... please do!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! She's called Miss Pumpkin!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wow... Ehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Come, a world of candy awaits us. Is
everyone
ready to say the spell? Let's go
to the gates
together!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rambunctious children go around

trick-or-treating with Meisho Doto
leading the
way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The parade concludes with no hiccups.
Judging
from her expression, Meisho
Doto is more than
pleased!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I had nothing to fear with the pumpkin
on. I didn't
lose my way, not even once...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... it wasn't just me. I'm not the one
who
revised the script on such short
notice, and
everyone stayed out late to
rehearse with me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...I'm truly glad they helped me make
this happen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Let us celebrate your success
together!
Come! We're all gathering in
the gymnasium!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! Opera O... you would d-do that
for me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! Opera O... you would d-do that
for me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Please wait for—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ack! Oof!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto, watch out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a close one. It's okay.
You don't
have to rush.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You h-helped me out again! I'm just so...
thank
you, thank you for everything!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I really mean it! You even helped me
rehearse
until right before the parade.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And Cafe brewed us coffee in between
practices,
even though I know she was as
tired as the rest of
us!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And to top it off, Opera O rewrote the
script for
my sake! You're all the best
friends I could ever
have!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, don't say all that! You've got me
blushing
over here!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Don't... tease me. But, I suppose you're
right... I'm happy
too, hehe.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Your words of praise
soothe my
spirit like a warm cup of
herbal tea! Please,
continue!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-sure thing! I've got plenty more!
